title: 火星监控录像
prompt: Grainy surveillance security camera footage from inside a Mars habitat airlock. High-angle top-down view. Elon Musk is sitting on a metal crate, looking up directly at the camera with a tired, manic expression. He is wearing a dirty SpaceX flight suit. The lighting is dim industrial red emergency lighting. Image quality is poor: video compression blocks, horizontal tracking lines, and noise. "REC" blinking icon and timecode in green font on screen.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 模型，捕捉火星监控录像的震撼画面，呈现电影级真实感，适用于航天机构、科幻制作及需要外星监控的安全模拟场景。
